control_flow: followInTheDark: if right light is below 60, check the line tracker; otherwise avoid walls.
In dim light: below 90 curve left, above 95 curve right, otherwise avoid walls.
avoidWalls: if left light is below 70, turn away from a left or right obstacle, otherwise drive in the dark; if bright, drive in the dark.
driveInTheDark: if left light is below 70, drive forward; otherwise stop at a wall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise follow the line.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.
